purpose: Create deterministic editorial media at the canonical frame rate and audio sample rate.
hard_gates: Output timing, source lineage, dimensions and audio stream integrity must validate.
soft_gates: The smallest sufficient intermediate should be used without degrading later analysis.

failure.fallback: Preserve ingest authority and stop before analysis until a valid normalized artifact exists.

regression_cases: Variable-frame-rate portrait input becomes constant 30 fps.
An input without usable audio remains an explicit capability state.
